preconditions.expression: all(1 <= n <= 10**5 and 0 <= m <= n for n, m in [(int(stdin.split()[0]), int(stdin.split()[1]))])
preconditions.description: Input contains integers n (number of suspects) and m (number of truthful answers) where 1 ≤ n ≤ 10^5 and 0 ≤ m ≤ n.
Input has exactly n+1 lines: first line with n and m, followed by n answer lines.

preconditions.expression: all('+' in line or '-' in line for line in stdin.splitlines()[1:])
preconditions.description: Each of the n answer lines starts with either '+' or '-' followed by an integer.

preconditions.expression: all(1 <= int(line[1:]) <= n for line in stdin.splitlines()[1:])
preconditions.description: For each answer line, the integer ai (after '+' or '-') satisfies 1 ≤ ai ≤ n.

postconditions.description: Output contains exactly n lines, one for each suspect.

postconditions.expression: all(line in ['Truth', 'Lie', 'Not defined'] for line in stdout.splitlines())
postconditions.description: Each output line is exactly one of 'Truth', 'Lie', or 'Not defined'.

postconditions.expression: all((line == 'Truth' and all(ai == i or (ai != i and (criminal != ai)) for i, line in enumerate(stdout.splitlines(), 1) if line == 'Truth')) or (line == 'Lie' and all(ai != i or (ai == i and (criminal != i)) for i, line in enumerate(stdout.splitlines(), 1) if line == 'Lie')) for criminal in range(1, n + 1) if sum(1 for i in range(1, n + 1) if (line := stdin.splitlines()[i])[0] == '+' and int(line[1:]) == criminal or (line[0] == '-' and int(line[1:]) != criminal)) == m)
postconditions.description: For each suspect i, the output line is 'Truth' if and only if suspect i tells the truth for every possible criminal that satisfies the m-truth condition. Similarly, 'Lie' if suspect i lies for every such criminal. Otherwise, 'Not defined'.

postconditions.expression: all((line == 'Truth' and any(ai == i or (ai != i and (criminal != ai)) for criminal in range(1, n + 1) if sum(1 for i in range(1, n + 1) if (line := stdin.splitlines()[i])[0] == '+' and int(line[1:]) == criminal or (line[0] == '-' and int(line[1:]) != criminal)) == m)) or (line == 'Lie' and any(ai != i or (ai == i and (criminal != i)) for criminal in range(1, n + 1) if sum(1 for i in range(1, n + 1) if (line := stdin.splitlines()[i])[0] == '+' and int(line[1:]) == criminal or (line[0] == '-' and int(line[1:]) != criminal)) == m)) for i, line in enumerate(stdout.splitlines(), 1))
postconditions.description: For each suspect i, if the output is 'Truth', there exists at least one criminal where suspect i tells the truth. If 'Lie', there exists at least one criminal where suspect i lies.
